newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges up in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.20 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 496.98 from 495.91 points on Monday. Total volume was only 663,468 dinars against 7.69 million dinars in the previous session.
Banque de Tunisie rose 2.5 dinars to 78 dinars with 1,094 shares changing hands.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF gained 1.01 dinar to 18.01 dinars with the exchange of 1,694 shares. Coca and beer bottler SFBT was up 0.78 dinar to 91.88.
BIAT bank rose 0.76 dinar to 36.76 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN was down one dinar to 36.2 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels slid 0.33 dinar to 11. Airline Tunis Air declined 0.1 dinar to 23.5 dinars with the exchange of 3,980 shares.
Trade was active on Investment fund Tuninvest-SICAF with 12,658 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 12.5 dinars. ($1=1.08 dinar) -- Tunis newsroom
